results.title: War of the Worlds
results.overview: Will Radford is a top analyst for Homeland Security who tracks potential threats through a mass surveillance program, until one day an attack by an unknown entity leads him to question whether the government is hiding something from him... and from the rest of the world.

results.title: The Source of Shadows
results.overview: This horror anthology film depicts ten tales of horror from twelve visionary directors as they take us on a journey to experience one of humanity’s most carnal fears; the fear of the unknown.

results.name: Top of the Pops
results.overview: The biggest stars, the most iconic performances, the most outrageous outfits – it’s Britain’s number one pop show.

results.name: The Wheel of Time
results.overview: The lives of five young villagers change forever when a strange and powerful woman arrives, claiming one of them is the child of an ancient prophecy with the power to tip the balance between Light and Dark forever. They must choose whether to trust this stranger – and each other – with the fate of the world before the Dark One breaks out of His prison, and the Last Battle begins.

results.name: The King of Queens
results.overview: Life’s good for deliveryman Doug Heffernan, until his newly widowed father-in-law, Arthur, moves in with him and his wife Carrie. Doug is no longer the king of his domain, and instead of having a big screen television in his recently renovated basement, he now has a crazy old man.

results.title: The Whales of August
results.overview: Two aged sisters reflect on life and the past during a late summer day in Maine.

results.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
results.original_name: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
results.overview: Beginning in a time of relative peace, we follow an ensemble cast of characters as they confront the re-emergence of evil to Middle-earth. From the darkest depths of the Misty Mountains, to the majestic forests of Lindon, to the breathtaking island kingdom of Númenor, to the furthest reaches of the map, these kingdoms and characters will carve out legacies that live on long after they are gone.

results.title: 009-1: The End of the Beginning
results.original_title: 009ノ1（ゼロゼロクノイチ） THE END OF THE BEGINNING
results.overview: In a universe where the Cold War never ended and growing conflicts result in the rapid advancement of technological warfare, the cyborg spy Mylene Hoffman of the 00 Organization battles the agents of the Eastern block in a game of high tech espionage.

results.name: Heirs of the Night
results.overview: 1889: the five remaining vampire clans in Europe are training to survive. In their midst is 14-year-old Alisa who has the power to choose between eternal life as a vampire or for all vampires to live as humans.

results.name: House of the Dragon
results.overview: The Targaryen dynasty is at the absolute apex of its power, with more than 15 dragons under their yoke. Most empires crumble from such heights. In the case of the Targaryens, their slow fall begins when King Viserys breaks with a century of tradition by naming his daughter Rhaenyra heir to the Iron Throne. But when Viserys later fathers a son, the court is shocked when Rhaenyra retains her status as his heir, and seeds of division sow friction across the realm.

results.title: Shadow of the Vampire
results.overview: Director F.W. Murnau makes a Faustian pact with a vampire to get him to star in his 1922 film "Nosferatu."

results.name: Match of the Day
results.overview:
BBC's football highlights and analysis.

"The longest-running football television programme in the world" as recognised by Guinness World Records in 2015.

results.name: The God of High School
results.original_name: THE GOD OF HIGH SCHOOL ゴッド・オブ・ハイスクール
results.overview: When an island half-disappears from the face of the earth, a mysterious organization sends out invitations for a tournament to every skilled fighter in the world. "If you win you can have ANYTHING you want," they claim. They're recruiting only the best to fight the best and claim the title of The God of High School. Jin Mori, a Taekwondo specialist and a high school student, soon learns that there is something much greater beneath the stage of the tournament.

results.name: Last of the Summer Wine
results.overview: Unencumbered by wives, jobs or any other responsibilities, three senior citizens who've never really grown up explore their world in the Yorkshire Dales. They spend their days speculating about their fellow townsfolk and thinking up adventures not usually favored by the elderly.  Last of the Summer Wine premiered as an episode of Comedy Playhouse in 1973. The show ran for 295 episodes until 2010. It is the longest running comedy Britain has produced and the longest running sitcom in the world.

results.name: King of the Hill
results.overview: Set in Texas, this animated series follows the life of propane salesman Hank Hill, who lives with his overly confident substitute Spanish teacher wife Peggy, wannabe comedian son Bobby, and naive niece Luanne. Hank has conservative views about God, family, and country, but his values and ethics are often challenged by the situations he, his family, and his beer-drinking neighbors/buddies find themselves in.

known_for.title: Mexican Blow
known_for.overview: The battle is on! A warrior from the South American jungle struggles against the Mexican drug cartel to free Mexico from violent oppression. But sometimes to ensure peace, war must be waged. To win this conflict, the regular rules of combat don't apply. This bloody confrontation will not be stopped with just guns and knives, more dangerous and powerful weapons are needed. Watch and be "BLOWN" away!

results.title: X-Rated 2: The Greatest Adult Stars of All-Time
results.original_title: X-Rated 2: The Greatest Adult Stars of All-Time
results.overview: Documentary sequel that offers a close-up look into the personal lives of the legendary porn stars who've survived the test of time and influenced popular culture. Blends rare interviews with erotic clips and additional appearances by Whoopi Goldberg, Steven Soderbergh and a host of adult stars, directors and trendsetters.

results.name: Craig of the Creek
results.overview: Craig and his friends, Kelsey and JP, venture out into a kid-controlled wilderness in the creek.

results.title: The Count of Monte Cristo
results.overview: Edmond Dantés's life and plans to marry the beautiful Mercedes are shattered when his best friend, Fernand, deceives him. After spending 13 miserable years in prison, Dantés escapes with the help of a fellow inmate and plots his revenge, cleverly insinuating himself into the French nobility.

results.title: My Left Foot: The Story of Christy Brown
results.original_title: My Left Foot: The Story of Christy Brown
results.overview: No one expects much from Christy Brown, a boy with cerebral palsy born into a working-class Irish family. Though Christy is a spastic quadriplegic and essentially paralyzed, a miraculous event occurs when, at the age of 5, he demonstrates control of his left foot by using chalk to scrawl a word on the floor. With the help of his steely mother — and no shortage of grit and determination — Christy overcomes his infirmity to become a painter, poet and author.
